findingDetails.scopeProof: The three cells were opened line by line on this tree and their content compared with the wording of the claim.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Printed lines 230-236 and 252-262 of implementation-summary.md, searched the file for the sixth-round paragraph and for limitations 6-8, and checked whether another line holds the described text.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A blank line at :232 points to an earlier edit that removed a line above, so the citation was true when written and the drift is a side effect rather than a wrong observation.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if the lines are corrected on this tree, or if the citation convention is declared to tolerate one-line drift.
